prevention: Require provider username bedrijfsgeheugen.nl before capability consumption or provider mutation.
Bind the numeric provider Instagram user id explicitly to create/publish calls.
Never infer identity from Composio alias, default status, Business account type, or Meta asset membership.
Wrong/missing identity is recoverable and cannot trigger Buffer, Make, direct-Meta fallback, regeneration, or replacement publication.
root_cause: Connection aliases and ACTIVE/BUSINESS status were treated as sufficient identity evidence, while the runtime could also fall back to Meta direct or Buffer. Provider username was not a hard pre-side-effect invariant.

evidence.provider_identity: Composio INSTAGRAM_GET_USER_INFO returned username arthurprinsen for connections aliased as Bedrijfsgeheugen.
evidence.business_asset: Meta Business Suite shows @bedrijfsgeheugen.nl assigned to the Bedrijfsgeheugen business portfolio with full access.
